properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The project's core signing curve — secp256k1 is the Ethereum protocol curve and is used throughout: anvil's backend (ec_recover_run, SignatureType::Secp256k1), the alloy/foundry-wallets signer paths (the literal-name sites are the visible tip; most production signing flows through alloy_signer_local::PrivateKeySigner wrappers), tempo session-policy authorization signing (crates/common/src/tempo/session_policy.rs:106-386), cast keychain secp256k1 access keys, the vm.sign-with-explicit-nonce cheat

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The generic ecdsa crate (0.16) plus k256's ECDSA — the digital-signature core of every local Ethereum signer path (alloy-signer-local via foundry-wallets, anvil, the vm.sign cheatcode). Same logical asset as the confirmed secp256k1 object (ALG-673c8f24), recorded here at the manifest level. Shor-vulnerable; migration is ML-DSA/SLH-DSA but only meaningful at the Ethereum protocol level.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test-time Ed25519 signing/verification (vm.signEd25519/vm.verifyEd25519/vm.createEd25519Key/vm.publicKeyEd25519, namespace-documented in cheatcodes.json) implemented in crates/cheatcodes/src/crypto.rs with the ed25519-consensus crate, plus trace-decoder display support in crates/evm/traces/src/decoder/mod.rs so decoded traces render these calls. Exists so Solidity tests can exercise contracts that verify Ed25519 signatures (e.g. Tempo keychain passkeys) — the scheme the chain enforces is protoco

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Test-time P-256/secp256r1 signing and public-key derivation (vm.signP256 etc., declared in cheatcodes.json with curve-order validation at crypto.rs:769) mirroring the chain's RIP-7212 P256VERIFY precompile, whose gas constants are carried in crates/evm/networks/src/lib.rs:1073. Passkey/WebAuthn-style flows on Tempo use this curve. Shor-vulnerable; replacement is a protocol/contract decision, not changeable in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 (x25519-dalek) in the dependency tree with no direct .rs call site in the workspace — available in the shipped build; any TLS session using it would come from the rustls/reqwest stack (rustls 0.23.45 + aws-lc-rs 1.18.1 configured, see ALG-f42564d9). Shor-vulnerable key agreement; hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768 is the migration target wherever it is actually negotiated.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 crates in the lockfile — ed25519-consensus 2.1 is a direct dependency of the cheatcodes crate implementing the vm Ed25519 cheatcodes (see the confirmed ALG-5e08bdf5); curve25519-dalek provides the backend (see LIB-f69df116/ALG-82f1eeb2). Shor-vulnerable signature scheme shipped in the binaries.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Curve25519 arithmetic (curve25519-dalek) in the dependency tree — the backend for ed25519-consensus (cheatcode Ed25519 ops) and x25519-dalek. Shipped in the binaries; Shor-vulnerable curve math.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: NIST P-256 ECDSA: p256 0.13 is a direct dependency of the cheatcodes crate for the vm.signP256/publicKeyP256 cheatcodes (crates/cheatcodes/src/crypto.rs:602) and sits in the revm precompile stack (Cargo.lock:10995). Shor-vulnerable; mirrors the chain's RIP-7212 precompile.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 (Ethereum's SHA-3-family hash, via alloy-primitives/keccak crates, asm-keccak feature): the EVM workhorse — transaction/block hashing in anvil (e.g. transaction/mod.rs:82), contract address derivation, the EVM keccak precompile via revm, config/cache fingerprints (anvil/src/config.rs:1328), plus [profile] opt-level and feature-flag entries. 630 sites across 155 files, overwhelmingly live hashing code. Classically strong; Grover-only, no Shor relevance; the variant is fixed by the EVM

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The AEAD layer of the client-side tempo zone ECIES deposit encryption (mirrored from tempoxyz/zones precompiles): ephemeral secp256k1 ECDH → HKDF-SHA256 (salt b"ecies-aes-key") → AES-256-GCM with a random 96-bit nonce (encryption.rs:53-56); the ciphertext+tag is submitted on-chain as the DepositPayload. AES-256-GCM is symmetric and PQ-adequate (Grover halves to 128-bit); the quantum exposure lives in the ECDH input, reported as a separate finding. Sites 106/120 are the #[cfg(test)] round-trip ve

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The KDF of the tempo zone ECIES: turns the secp256k1 ECDH shared x-coordinate into the 32-byte AES-256-GCM key, with a 104-byte info string binding portal address, key index, ephemeral x and sender (encryption.rs:41-49) for domain separation. HKDF-SHA256 itself is PQ-safe; the shared secret it consumes is Shor-recoverable (reported separately as the ECDH agreement). Sites 103/116 are #[cfg(test)] vectors.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Memory-hard KDF of Ethereum keystore files (Web3 Secret Storage v3): the scrypt crate is in the dependency tree and perf-tuned in the root [profile] under the "# Keystores." comment (Cargo.toml:242); the encrypt/decrypt itself happens inside eth-keystore (pulled by the external foundry-wallets crate — see Cargo.lock:6499) for cast wallet keystore import/export. No direct workspace call site; scrypt n/r/p parameters are eth-keystore defaults.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The MAC primitive behind the live HS256 engine-API JWT signing (crates/common/src/provider/runtime_transport.rs:450 and curl_transport.rs:132, via alloy-rpc-types-engine with the jwt-aws-lc-rs feature — jsonwebtoken 10.4.0 + aws-lc-rs backend), and inside PBKDF2/BIP39 in the signer stack. No direct workspace call site; the live JWT sites are reported as a separate finding. HMAC-SHA256 is Grover-only (≥128-bit PQ security).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Password-based KDF inside the dependency tree: BIP39 mnemonic→seed derivation (coins-bip39 via alloy-signer-local, exercised by the vm.createWallet/MnemonicBuilder cheatcode paths in crates/cheatcodes/src/crypto.rs:6-12) and Ethereum keystore-file decryption (eth-keystore via foundry-wallets). Iteration counts are library/protocol defaults (BIP39: 2048 × HMAC-SHA512), not configured in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Non-security-purpose use: Sha256::new() at crates/common/src/external_compiler.rs:276 fingerprints discovered compilation units for the external-compiler disk cache (integrity/dedup, not a cryptographic control). PQ-safe hash (Grover-only); the same sha2 crate feeds HKDF-SHA256 in the tempo ECIES.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 via the sha2 crate: a real direct dependency — cast uses it as the HKDF hash in the tempo ECIES (Hkdf::<Sha256> at encryption.rs:47), common uses it for compiler fingerprints, and the tree uses it inside HS256 JWTs. PQ-adequate.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE3 in the dependency tree (transitive — compiler/tooling artifact hashing such as foundry-compilers/svm paths); no direct workspace call site found. Fast general-purpose hash, PQ-safe (Grover-only).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The 256-bit symmetric key of the tempo zone ECIES: HKDF-SHA256 output instantiated as Aes256Gcm at encryption.rs:54 (live) and :106/:120 (tests). PQ-adequate (Grover halves to 128-bit). Same code chain as the confirmed AES-GCM object.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD available in the shipped dependency tree (transitive — no direct workspace call site found); strong classical AEAD, PQ-adequate (256-bit key → 128-bit under Grover).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ring 0.17.14 (Cargo.lock:11096) is compiled in as rustls's alternate crypto provider — rustls 0.23.45 depends on both aws-lc-rs (the provider configured via workspace features) and ring. No direct workspace call site. ring is a classical-only crypto provider; the PQ-capable path in this build is aws-lc-rs. Changeable here: provider selection is a build-feature decision in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The aes-gcm crate is the AEAD of the tempo zone ECIES (live at crates/cast/src/cmd/tempo/zone/encryption.rs:54; cast declares it) — see the confirmed ALG-f61ec50f for the same asset's algorithm-level entry. PQ-adequate symmetric encryption.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: rustls 0.23.45 — the TLS backend for all shipped HTTP/WebSocket clients (reqwest-rustls-tls feature of the mpp transport; also under gcloud-sdk's reqwest). With aws-lc-rs 1.18.1 as the configured provider it can negotiate hybrid PQ groups where peers support them; PQ readiness is version-dependent and upgradeable in this repo. See ALG-f42564d9.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The sha2 crate (SHA-256) — direct dependency with live use: HKDF-SHA256 in the tempo ECIES (encryption.rs:47) and compiler-cache fingerprinting (external_compiler.rs:276). PQ-adequate. See ALG-928ac765/ALG-695a1eb5.

properties.name: pqs:context
